content: GitHub Actions for Pico: ubuntu-latest, install cmake gcc-arm-none-eabi libnewlib-arm-none-eabi libstdc++-arm-none-eabi-newlib. Set PICO_SDK_PATH by cloning raspberrypi/pico-sdk or pass via cmake -DPICO_SDK_PATH. cmake -DPICO_BOARD=pico_w .. && make -j4 produces textreader.uf2. Upload with actions/upload-artifact@v4. For pico2_w: cmake -DPICO_BOARD=pico2_w. Matrix strategy can build both boards.
